mpc-painting-lessons.name: My Painting Club — Painting Lesson Knowledge Base
mpc-painting-lessons.description: Search transcribed painting lessons from mypaintingclub.com. Covers colour mixing, edges, composition, value, brushwork, oils and acrylics. Every answer cites the lesson page and the exact video timestamp.

tools.name: search_painting_lessons
tools.description: Search painting lesson content with a natural-language question. Returns ranked answers with lesson page URL and Vimeo timestamp deep link.

mpc-painting-lessons.rateLimit: 30 requests/minute per IP; 500 queries/day global cap (resets midnight UTC)
